title: January 15, 2022 Tonga volcano-generated tsunami propagation
description:
Propagation of the January 15, 2022, Tonga volcano-generated tsunami was computed with the NOAA forecast method using MOST model via inversion of Gaussian-shape sources developed in real time. From the NOAA Center for Tsunami Research, located at NOAA PMEL in Seattle, WA. See https://nctr.pmel.noaa.gov/tonga20220115/ #TsunamiPropagation
NOAA NCTR experimental research product. Not an official forecast.
